translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Bllin Páblona' len Bernabéna' Icóniona'

Na' ka bllin Páblona' len Bernabéna' Icóniona', wyajgake' gana' chdop chllag beṉ' Israelka' choe'ḻwillgake' Chioza'. Na' Chioza' goklene' ḻegake' ka be'gake' cho'a xtilleena' kwenc̱he beṉ' zan benḻilall'gake' Jesúza', ka beṉ' Israel na' ka beṉ' bi nak beṉ' Israel.
Na' beṉ' Israelka', beṉ'ka' bi goni shajḻe' c̱he Jesúza', wlooyeḻ'gake' baḻ beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel kwenc̱he gokzbangakile' beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesúza'.

Daan bigaaṉ Páblona' len Bernabéna' Icóniona' ssha, na' be'gake' xtill' X̱ancho Jesúza' na' bi bllebgake', ḻa' nx̱enilall'gake' zoalen X̱ancho Chioza' ḻegake'. Na' X̱anchona' goklene' ḻegake' bli'gake' yeḻ' wak c̱he'na' kwenc̱he gokbe'i beṉ' nan choe'gake' dill' ḻi.
Na' beṉ' Icónioka' gokgake' c̱hoplə, baḻe' wda'gake' beṉ' Israelka' na' zi baḻe' wda'gake' Páblona' len Bernabéna'.
Na'ch beṉ' Israelka' bengake' txen beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel na' gokgake' toz len beṉ' wṉabia'ka', goklall'gake' yiya dii gongakile' Páblona' len Bernabéna' na' wlliagake' ḻegake' yaj.
Na' ka wṉezi Páblona' len Bernabéna' ka ba chwia beṉ'ka' gongakile' ḻegake', lii biza'tegake', wyajgake' yell Lístrana' na' yell Dérbena', yellka' llia gana' mbani Licaóniana'.
Na' ḻekzka' be'gake' dill' wen dill' kob c̱he Jesúza' na'.
Blliagake' Páblona' yaj yell Lístrana'
Na' Lístrana' jadi'gake' to beṉ' nxiṉj ṉi'ena' ka goljtie'. Na' bi chak see daa bi chzoa c̱hec̱h ṉi'ena'.
Na' chi'e chzenague' dillaa choe' Páblona'. Na' Páblona' chwie'ne' na' gokbe'ile' chajḻi'e wak yiyon Chioza' ḻe' kwenc̱he gak see.
Na'ch golle'ne' zillj: ―Wzolla'. Na' lii wzolla'tie' na' gok wzee.
Ka ble'i beṉ' Lístraka' daa ben Páblona', wzolo chosyaagake' chṉegake' xtilleeka' daa nak dill' Licaonia che'gake': ―¡Ba betj chios c̱hechoka' gani zoacho na' chle'gakichone' ka beṉec̱h!
Na' wnagake' Bernabéna' nake' chios c̱he'ka' beena' nsi'gake' Júpiter, na' Páblona' nake' chios c̱he'ka' beena' nsi'gake' Mercurio, ḻa' ḻen' cho'e dillaa.

Na' bx̱oz c̱he yoodo' c̱he Júpitera', daa zoa katez choogake' yella', jwee gooṉka' na' nwaḻee ḻegakb bga de yej, na' ḻe', na' beṉ'ka' ndop nllag na', goklall'gake' witgake' ḻegakb kwenc̱he we'la'ogake' Páblona' len Bernabéna'.
Na' ka gokbe'i Bernabéna' len Páblona' bin gon beṉ'ka', na' wzologake' bc̱hez' xe'ka', ḻa' chakgakile' dii mal nlleban chon beṉ'ka'. Na' jsedogake' ladje'ka', na' wṉegake' zillj, che'gake':

―Le' beṉ'do', ¿berac̱he chonzle ka'? Ḻekzka' beṉ' yell-lioz neto', ka le', na' ba bidnto' kwenc̱he wzajniinto' le' chiyaḻ' kwejyic̱hjle diiki bibi zak' na' gonḻilall'le Chios, beṉ' yaa beṉ' banna', beena' ben yabana', yell-lioni, na' nisdo'na', na' yog' dii de xan yabana', lo yell-lioni, na' ḻoo nisdo'na'.
Kani'yi Chioza' bwialoze' c̱he beṉec̱ha' bengake' kon daa nazan c̱hegake'.

Na' ḻa'kzi bwialoze' ka bengake', bliile' ḻegake' yeḻ' wak c̱he'na' kwenc̱he ka' gakbe'gakile' zoe'. Ḻa' ḻen' chone' yeja' kwenc̱he chak dii chaz chaaṉcho na' chat' dii cheej chaocho kwenc̱he soacho mbalaz.
Na' ḻa'kzi Páblona' len Bernabéna' gollgake' ka', kaṉi goongakile' bi witgake' gooṉka' daa nan we'la'ogake' ḻegake'.

Na' bllin baḻ beṉ' Israelka' zaak Antioquíana' na' Icóniona', na' wlooyeḻ'gake' beṉ' Lístraka' kwenc̱he blliagake' Páblona' yaja'. Na' daa gokgakile' ba witen', na'ch bx̱obgake'ne' jadix̱jgake'ne' cho'a yella'te.
Na' beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesúza' bdi'a bllaggake' gana' de Páblona', na' biyase' biyo'e yella' sto shii. Na' betiyo bizee len Bernabéna' na' biyajgake' yell Dérbena'.
Na' ḻekzka' wdix̱jeegake' dill' wen dill' kob c̱he Jesúza' yell Dérbena', na' beṉ' zan benḻilall'gake' Jesúza'. Na'tech, biza'gake' bidegake' yell Lístrana', Icóniona' na'ch Antioquíana'.

Na' to to yellka' gana' bidegake' btipgake' lall' beṉ'ka' ba chajḻe' c̱he Jesúza' kwenc̱he soac̱hec̱hgake' gonḻilall'chgake'ne'. Na' gollgake' chiyaḻ' yizo yizakicho bittez dii yen ile'icho kwenc̱he gak lljazoalencho Chioza' gana' chṉabi'e.

Na' to to yellka' wlejgake' to c̱hop beṉ' koo lall' na'gake' beṉ'ka' ba nonḻilall'gake' Jesúza'. Na' wzoagake' wbas' be'ḻwillgake' Chioza', na'ch bengake' ḻegake' lall' na' X̱ancho Jesúza', beena' nonḻilall'gake'.
Páblona' len Bernabéna' biyajgake' yell Antioquíana' daa llia gana' mbani Síriana'
Na' wde Páblona' len Bernabéna' gana' mbani Pisídiana' na' bllingake' gana' mbani Panfíliana'.
Na' be'gake' cho'a xtill' Chioza' yell Pérgena'. Na'ch biza'gake' ziyajgake' yell Atáliana'.
Na' yell Atáliana' biyoogake' to ḻoo barkw na' billingake' yell Antioquíana' gana' lle' beṉ'ka' bengake' ḻegake' lo na' Chioza' kana' bseḻ'gake' ḻegake' lljengake' llinna' daa ba biyoll jengake'.

Na' ka billingake' yell Antioquíana', btopgake' beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesúza', na' gollgake' yog' daa goklen Chioza' ḻegake' to to yellka'. Na' ḻekzka' gollgake' ka ben Chioza' bi'e latj c̱he beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel kwenc̱he benḻilall'gake' Jesúza'.
Na' Páblona' len Bernabéna' bigaaṉgake' ssha yell Antioquíana' len beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesúza'.
